description: This file defines the 'Module' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Setting' namespace. The class provides methods to manage modules such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving module data from the database. It extends the base system Model class in OpenCart and interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to modules.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: A model class managing CRUD operations for modules in the OpenCart admin setting context.

methods.name: addModule
methods.description: Inserts a new module record into the database with provided code and data.

methods.name: editModule
methods.description: Updates an existing module's details identified by module_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteModule
methods.description: Deletes a module from the database by its module_id.

methods.name: deleteModulesByCode
methods.description: Deletes all modules from the database matching the specified code.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Retrieves the settings of a specific module identified by module_id.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Fetches all modules ordered by their code.

methods.name: getModulesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves all modules that match a given code, ordered by name.
